composition_variation: Create a playful graphic anime wallpaper of Yuji Itadori seated on a low round stool in a bright sneaker studio. Preserve his short pink hair, warm brown eyes, and friendly youthful expression, without additional facial markings. Dress him in a loose red hoodie, black joggers, and comfortable white sneakers. He bends slightly forward to adjust one shoe tongue, keeping the hands simple and visible. Use sky-blue flooring, warm coral geometric panels, soft cream light, and broad uncluttered upper color fields. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
